summary: STAK Inc., a Nasdaq-listed China-based oilfield equipment maker, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release, notices of meetings, and proxy forms. It will convene a Class A ordinary share meeting on October 9, 2026 in Changzhou, followed immediately by an extraordinary general meeting. Holders of record as of September 4, 2026 may vote. The filing discloses no transaction terms, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation beyond meeting logistics. This is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation; no deal or risk-arb angle applies.
